We go and dig holes in the conservation agriculture field from about 13 years old

Reasons for ending education
• Lack of money for school fees
• Due to bad behavior and falling pregnant whilst still in school
• Failure to listen to their parents
• No interest in education and sell books meant for school
• There are girls who sell their books so as to buy foodstuff at the school tuck shop. Eventually they stop coming to school
• Illness may stop someone from continuing with their education
• Eloping after falling pregnant whilst still in school
• Distance also causes some of the girls to drop out of school because it is too far for them to travel. If the girl is always being beaten up for being late for school, she will get to a point where she no longer wants to go there
• Sexual advances that they receive from teachers. Such a teacher may chase the student around the school the whole day and beat her up till she no longer wants to go to school
• Sometimes step mothers refuse to pay school fees or buy school material for their step daughters
• Another may be staying with a stepmother who does not provide her with food. The girl may later find a boy who is willing to give her food and she ends up sleeping with that boy and getting pregnant
• Some of the girls elope to commuter omnibus drivers because of the money that they receive

Two most important reasons
• Lack of money to pay school fees
• Getting pregnant whilst still in school

2. falling pregnant whilst still in school

New agricultural or NRM practices
• CONSERVATION AGRICULTURE
• Making basins for planting
• Putting manure directly into the hole and not just spreading it all over the field
• Putting dead leaves manure into the hole if I do not have cattle
• Putting fertilizer into each hole using a Coca-Cola bottle top as measurement
• Using grass for mulching
• NATURAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
• Avoid stream bank cultivation
• Avoiding deforestation. Nowadays one can be arrested for cutting a tree without telling the village head
• Avoiding digging holes everywhere unnecessarily
• OTHER FARMING PRACTICES
• Making contour ridges
• LIVESTOCK PRACTICES
• We learnt of the right medication for chickens when they are ill. Previously we would just give them aloe Vera for any condition
• The cattle must be dipped and vaccinated regularly

[Why do young women rank basins as most important?] It does not waste fertilizer or manure because you place it straight into the hole
One is guaranteed of having a high yield even if they just plant on a small area. The yield is even better than of a person who used cattle for ploughing
It conserves soil and also conserves moisture
The good thing about is that even if you do not have cattle, you can still grow your crops and have a good harvest
[Why do you young women rank contour ridges as second important?] The ridges conserve soil and it is not washed away
The crop is also not washed away
The ridges also conserve water and the field remains moist
[Why do young men rank basins as most important?] The reasons are the same as to why young women prefer basins

The donkeys were very important in 2004 but not anymore. Back then, there were few cars and the donkeys were used for transportation to take the maize to the millers as well as draught power for other purposes

I think that making basins has caused some of the changes. This is especially in the way we grow crops in the way we now grow crops. People used to plant their crops in a very disorderly manner, now there is order through the row and in- row spacing
We used to grow groundnuts without leaving much space in between. This would make it very difficult to hoe weed. Nowadays we leave enough space between the crops
Now we also grow cow peas using the basin method. Previously, it was not like that. We used to plough using cattle and then plant

I think that farming practices have changed also because times are moving and there are a whole of changes that also take place with the inventions of new farming tools and discoveries of new farming methods therefore no one wants to be left behind in trying out new things
Traditionally, the boys were the ones who would use the ox drawn plough in the field but now the girls do the same job
Customarily, the men did not weed in the groundnuts patch. This is still happening up to now
Long time ago, the men and women used to help each other to perform all the agricultural chores. The people were very united but not anymore

Traditionally, women used to grow millet because there used to be a lot of beer brewing for different occasions. People also used to eat millet sadza. However, this does not happen anymore because they now rely on the good yield they get from maize
He would face challenges when it came to plucking and harvesting the groundnuts. Men do not have the patience to sit and pluck out the groundnuts
There is no particularly crop that we could say is for men or women. If a woman decided to grow maize, she would not face any challenges because she is used to helping in the maize fields

Nowadays, people no longer divide their plots. The land generally belongs to the whole family. So the mother and father will agree on the plots to plant different crops. The mother is usually allocated a piece of land by the father to grow her crops such as groundnuts
Men do not help their wives to hoe their groundnuts. Men do not have the patience to go through the whole process from planting to harvesting.
